info.description: Preview of the Discord v10 HTTP API specification. See https://discord.com/developers/docs for more details.

X-RateLimit-Bucket.description: The bucket that the request belongs to

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: The maximum number of requests that can be made in the current ratelimit window

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: The number of requests remaining in the current ratelimit window

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: A unix timestamp in seconds at which the current ratelimit window resets

X-RateLimit-Reset-After.description: The duration in seconds until the current ratelimit window resets
